title: Adaptation Needs in Robotic Systems: Assessing Behavior Trees and Their Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2609.05331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic systems increasingly operate in dynamic, uncertain, and open-ended environments, where design-time assumptions may no longer hold, and adaptation becomes necessary to maintain effective and safe operation. Behavior Trees (BTs) are widely used in robotic control architectures due to their modularity, readability, and reactivity. This raises a central question: are BTs sufficient to meet the adaptation needs of modern robotic systems?   This paper investigates this question through a literature-driven study complemented by empirical validation. First, we derive a classification of robotic adaptation needs from the literature, organizing them into six categories: Knowledge, Perception, Actuation, System, Mission, and Environment. Then, we analyze the capabilities and limitations of classical BTs with respect to these needs. translated_title: 机器人系统中的适应需求：评估行为树及其增强方法
translated_abstract: 机器人系统越来越多地在动态、不确定和开放式环境中运行，在这种情况下，设计阶段的假设可能不再成立，因此需要适应性来维持有效且安全的运行。行为树因其模块化、可读性和反应性而被广泛应用于机器人控制架构中。这就引出了一个核心问题：行为树是否足以满足现代机器人系统的适应需求？本文通过一项以文献为基础并结合实证验证的研究来探讨这一问题。首先，我们从文献中归纳出机器人适应需求的分类，将其组织为六个类别：知识、感知、执行、系统、任务和环境。随后，我们针对这些需求分析了经典行为树的能力与局限性。接着，我们对现有文献中基于行为树的适应方法进行了特征化描述，并将其组织为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从文献中归纳出机器人系统的六类适应需求（知识、感知、执行、系统、任务、环境），评估了经典行为树在满足这些需求方面的能力与局限，并系统梳理了基于行为树的适应增强方法。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a six-category classification of robotic adaptation needs, assesses the capabilities and limitations of classical Behavior Trees against these needs, and systematically characterizes BT-based adaptation approaches from the literature.
